item.title: #8 Tigers down #24 Lindsey Wilson 27-17
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – On Tuesday night, the rivalry showdown lived up to the hype as the #8 Campbellsville University men's wrestling team defeated #24 Lindsey Wilson College in the "Battle of Highway 55." item.title: Speed, depth define 2026 Baseball Tigers
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – Following a 2025 campaign that saw the Tigers capture an NCCAA Regional Championship and make a World Series appearance, the Campbellsville University baseball team is set to open the 2026 season this Friday with a revamped roster and a new tactical identity.

item.title: Craft surges to #2, Tigers move to #15 in latest NAIA Poll
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) released the sixth Women's Wrestling Coaches' Top 20 Poll of the 2025-26 season on Thursday. The Campbellsville University women's wrestling team climbed two spots to #15, accumulating 58 points in the national rating.

item.title: Tigers receive votes in first-ever NAIA Flag Football Preseason Poll
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. — The Campbellsville University Flag Football team, two weeks from their season debut, were announced as receiving votes in the first-ever NAIA Women's Flag Football Top-Ten, the national office announced Thursday.

item.title: #8 Tigers topple #11 Cumberland 29-10; dominate Midway 47-9
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – Thursday night delivered a statement double victory for the #8 Campbellsville University men's wrestling team. The Tigers dismantled #11 Cumberland University (Tenn.) 29-10 behind a trio of high-profile upsets before rolling past Midway University 47-9 to close out the regular season home slate. item.title: #4 Lady Tigers force 26 turnovers, down Georgetown 78-67
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The #4 Campbellsville University Lady Tigers hosted rival (RV) Georgetown College on Thursday night at the Powell Athletic Center. By forcing more than double the turnovers of their opponent, Campbellsville dominated the defensive end to secure another Mid-South Conference victory, 78-67.

item.title: Trio of Tigers score 20+ as Campbellsville upsets #15 Georgetown, 86-76
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team hosted Mid-South Conference rival and 15th-ranked Georgetown College on Thursday night. Fueled by a blistering offensive performance and a dominant showing from their bench, the Tigers defeated Georgetown for the first time since 2020, securing an 86-76 victory inside the Powell Athletic Center.

item.title: Tigers stay perfect, topple St. Ambrose and #10 Benedictine Mesa at Mighty Oak Invite
item.description: OAKLAND CITY, Ind. — The #9 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team continued its unbeaten start to the 2026 campaign, securing two hard-fought victories on day one of the Mighty Oak Invite hosted by Oakland City University. item.title: Tigers walk off CIU in season opener, fall to #11 William Carey in nightcap
item.description: HATTIESBURG, Miss. – The Campbellsville University baseball team opened the 2026 campaign with a split on Friday, securing a dramatic 5-4 walk-off victory over Columbia International University before falling 6-0 to host #11 William Carey University.
